title: RigorQuant literature negative-exports.json
description: The provenance-stripped constraints sent to the novel lane. Every export must trace to a known-results entry with category 'impossible' and a verified-current source; rq_check.py enforces that subset rule (a negative cannot appear from nowhere).

constraint.description: the provenance-stripped constraint text shown to the novel lane (no author, title, or source id)

source_paper_id.description: the orchestrator-side source id this constraint came from; must match a verified impossible entry
